scripts.build:server: rimraf out && cross-env NODE_ENV=production ENABLE_WHMCS_INTEGRATION=true next build && echo 'Server build complete, Next runtime output:' && ls -la .next/
scripts.build:static: echo 'Static export is retired in this repo now that authenticated WHMCS client-area routes are restored. Use npm run build for the deployable runtime.' && exit 1
scripts.serve:static: echo 'Static preview serving is retired in this repo. Start the server runtime with npm run start instead.' && exit 1
scripts.screenshot: npm run playwright:install && npx playwright test tests/screenshot.spec.ts --project=chromium --reporter=list
scripts.build:debug: rimraf out && cross-env NODE_ENV=production ENABLE_WHMCS_INTEGRATION=true next build && echo 'Server build completed' && ls -la .next/
